mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition (UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000) is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint effect is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over three consecutive months are not followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2% year-over-year, it signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition (FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 YoY > 2%) is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint effect is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals weakening supply-side conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 2% in 1 quarter is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
